navaid.name: NOAAS Oscar Dyson
navaid.description: Primarily operating in the Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska, NOAA Ship Oscar Dyson is the first in a class of ultra-quiet fisheries survey vessels collecting data on fish populations, conduct marine mammal and seabird surveys, and study marine ecosystems.
